label: Formal fact: if every POTENCY_1 is of the contradictory, a being that…, from incorruptible facts
meaning: Formal facts (no premises). The three sourced readings STMT-EVERY-POTENCY-IS-OF-CONTRADICTION, STMT-INCORRUPTIBLE-PRIOR-IN-SUBSTANCE-TO-CORRUPTIBLE and STMT-INCORRUPTIBLE-IS-IN-ACT-IN-SUBSTANCE (Met. IX.8, 1050b6-18; In Metaph. IX, lect. 9 n. 1-6), together with two unattributed hypotheses stated inside the facts (some being is incorruptible simply; priority in substance is simple priority), entail act's simple priority over potency in substance, without any premise about motion; each of the five is needed. With non-simultaneity this excludes a first being's potency in substance. It does not reach STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY or the root's use of it in ST I q.3 a.1: a model of every prima via premise, the mover-priority bridge, the motion route's priority over potencies being actualized and all five premises has a first mover moved by none, first being and incorruptible simply, in potency in a respect other than substance (a place, in the witness) in which it is not moved. The five readings do not exclude that: lect. 9 n. 6 allows potency secundum quid in simply incorruptible beings (its examples are moved bodies, not a first mover). Not recorded as an argument for STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY. Discharges nothing.
